sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन चाभिवाद्य प्रदक्षिणम् ।कृत्वा पितामहं तूर्णं प्रययौ वरुणालयम् ।। ७.५६.११ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastu devena cābhivādya pradakṣiṇam ।kṛtvā pitāmahaṁ tūrṇaṁ prayayau varuṇālayam ।। 7.56.11 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to by the god, and having saluted and circumambulated the grandfather Brahma, he quickly went to the abode of Varuna.
